mapper.select: SELECT A_MAIN_NO AS aMainNo, A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType FROM PC_ANIMAL_MAIN ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO
SELECT A_SUB_NO AS aSubNo, A_MAIN_NO AS aMainNo, A_SUB_TYPE AS aSubType FROM PC_ANIMAL_SUB ORDER BY A_MAIN_NO, A_SUB_NO
SELECT I_MAIN_NO AS iMainNo, I_MAIN_TYPE AS iMainType FROM PC_ITEM_MAIN ORDER BY I_MAIN_NO
SELECT I_SUB_NO AS iSubNo, I_MAIN_NO AS iMainNo, I_SUB_TYPE AS iSubType FROM PC_ITEM_SUB ORDER BY I_MAIN_NO, I_SUB_NO

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.BRAND AS brand, P.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, P.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS productStatus, DATE_FORMAT(P.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d') AS cdate,
ASM.A_MAIN_NO AS aMainNo, ASM.A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType, ASB.A_SUB_NO AS aSubNo, ASB.A_SUB_TYPE AS aSubType,
IM.I_MAIN_NO AS iMainNo, IM.I_MAIN_TYPE AS iMainType, ISB.I_SUB_NO AS iSubNo, ISB.I_SUB_TYPE AS iSubType,
CONCAT(F.FILE_PATH, F.FILE_NAME) AS img,
IFNULL(R.avgRating, 0) AS avgRating, IFNULL(R.reviewCnt, 0) AS reviewCnt
FROM PRODUCT P
LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB ASB ON P.A_SUB_NO = ASB.A_SUB_NO
LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN ASM ON ASB.A_MAIN_NO = ASM.A_MAIN_NO
LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB ISB ON P.I_SUB_NO = ISB.I_SUB_NO
LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_MAIN IM ON ISB.I_MAIN_NO = IM.I_MAIN_NO
LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_NO = F.PRODUCT_NO
LEFT JOIN ( SELECT PRODUCT_NO, ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1) AS avgRating, COUNT(*) AS reviewCnt FROM `REVIEW` WHERE PRODUCT_NO IS NOT NULL GROUP BY PRODUCT_NO ) R ON P.PRODUCT_NO = R.PRODUCT_NO
WHERE P.PRODUCT_STATUS = 'Y'
AND P.PRODUCT_NAME LIKE CONCAT('%', #{keyword}, '%')
AND ASM.A_MAIN_NO = #{aMainNo}
AND P.A_SUB_NO = #{aSubNo}
AND IM.I_MAIN_NO = #{iMainNo}
AND P.I_SUB_NO = #{iSubNo}
ORDER BY IFNULL(R.reviewCnt, 0) DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY IFNULL(R.avgRating, 0) DESC, IFNULL(R.reviewCnt, 0) DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_PRICE ASC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_PRICE DESC, P.PRODUCT_NO DESC
ORDER BY P.PRODUCT_NO DESC

SELECT FILE_NO AS fileNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_NAME AS fileName, ORIGIN_NAME AS originName, FILE_SIZE AS fileSize, FILE_EXT AS fileExt, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS fileUrl, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS img FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY FILE_NO

SELECT FILE_NO AS fileNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_NAME AS fileName, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS fileUrl, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS img FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND IS_MAIN = 'Y' ORDER BY FILE_NO

SELECT FILE_NO AS fileNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, FILE_PATH AS filePath, FILE_NAME AS fileName, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS fileUrl, CONCAT(FILE_PATH, FILE_NAME) AS img FROM PRODUCT_FILE WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} AND IS_DETAIL = 'Y' ORDER BY FILE_NO

SELECT REVIEW_NO AS reviewNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, USER_ID AS userId, RATING AS rating, R_CONTENTS AS contents, R_CONTENTS AS reviewContents, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cdate, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS reviewCdate FROM REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY REVIEW_NO DESC

SELECT Q.QNA_NO AS qnaNo, Q.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, Q.USER_ID AS userId, IFNULL(NULLIF(U.NICKNAME, ''), Q.USER_ID) AS writerNickname, Q.QNA_TITLE AS qnaTitle, Q.Q_CONTENTS AS qnaContents, Q.A_CONTENTS AS qnaAnswer, Q.ANS_STATUS AS qnaStatus, Q.IS_SECRET AS privateYn, DATE_FORMAT(Q.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS qnaCdate, CASE WHEN Q.ADATE IS NULL THEN '' ELSE DATE_FORMAT(Q.ADATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') END AS updateTime FROM QNA Q LEFT JOIN USERS U ON Q.USER_ID = U.USER_ID WHERE Q.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo} ORDER BY Q.QNA_NO DESC

SELECT C.CART_NO AS cartNo, C.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, C.QTY AS qty, C.QTY AS cartQty, DATE_FORMAT(C.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cdate,
P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, P.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty,
(C.QTY * P.PRODUCT_PRICE) AS totalPrice,
F.FILE_NO AS fileNo, F.FILE_PATH AS filePath, F.FILE_NAME AS fileName, CONCAT(F.FILE_PATH, F.FILE_NAME) AS img FROM CART C JOIN PRODUCT P ON C.PRODUCT_NO = P.PRODUCT_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON C.PRODUCT_NO = F.PRODUCT_NO AND F.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE C.USER_ID = #{userId} ORDER BY C.CART_NO DESC

SELECT P.PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, P.STORE_NO AS storeNo, P.PRODUCT_NAME AS productName, P.BRAND AS brand, P.PRODUCT_PRICE AS productPrice, P.STOCK_QTY AS stockQty, P.A_SUB_NO AS aSubNo, P.I_SUB_NO AS iSubNo, P.PRODUCT_STATUS AS productStatus, DATE_FORMAT(P.CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cdate,
AM.A_MAIN_NO AS aMainNo, AM.A_MAIN_TYPE AS aMainType, ASUB.A_SUB_TYPE AS aSubType,
IM.I_MAIN_NO AS iMainNo, IM.I_MAIN_TYPE AS iMainType, ISUB.I_SUB_TYPE AS iSubType,
CONCAT(F.FILE_PATH, F.FILE_NAME) AS img FROM PRODUCT P LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_SUB ASUB ON P.A_SUB_NO = ASUB.A_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ANIMAL_MAIN AM ON ASUB.A_MAIN_NO = AM.A_MAIN_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_SUB ISUB ON P.I_SUB_NO = ISUB.I_SUB_NO LEFT JOIN PC_ITEM_MAIN IM ON ISUB.I_MAIN_NO = IM.I_MAIN_NO LEFT JOIN PRODUCT_FILE F ON P.PRODUCT_NO = F.PRODUCT_NO AND F.IS_MAIN = 'Y' WHERE P.PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
SELECT COUNT(*) AS reviewCount, IFNULL(ROUND(AVG(RATING), 1), 0) AS avgRating FROM REVIEW WHERE PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}

SELECT QNA_NO AS qnaNo, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, USER_ID AS userId, QNA_TITLE AS qnaTitle, Q_CONTENTS AS qnaContents, A_CONTENTS AS qnaAnswer, ANS_STATUS AS qnaStatus, IS_SECRET AS privateYn, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS qnaCdate FROM QNA WHERE QNA_NO = #{qnaNo}

SELECT CART_NO AS cartNo, USER_ID AS userId, PRODUCT_NO AS productNo, QTY AS qty, QTY AS cartQty, DATE_FORMAT(CDATE, '%Y-%m-%d %H:%i:%s') AS cdate FROM CART WHERE USER_ID = #{userId} AND PRODUCT_NO = #{productNo}
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO QNA ( PRODUCT_NO, USER_ID, QNA_TITLE, Q_CONTENTS, ANS_STATUS, IS_SECRET, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{productNo}, #{userId}, #{title}, #{contents}, 'N', #{secretYn}, NOW() )
INSERT INTO CART ( USER_ID, PRODUCT_NO, QTY, CDATE ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{productNo}, #{qty}, NOW() )
